runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
**OMB M-25-22, *Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government* (April 2025), governs federal AI acquisition.** It is the later memo, and it explicitly supersedes the earlier one. It is issued consistent with the Advancing American AI Act, Executive Order 14179, and OMB Memorandum M-25-21, and it gives agencies guidance for improving their ability to acquire AI responsibly.

The earlier acquisition memo was OMB M-24-18, *Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government* (October 2024). M-25-22 cancels it outright: it rescinds and replaces M-24-18. Because the later memo explicitly replaces the earlier one, M-25-22 is the operative guidance, and agencies should not rely on M-24-18.

The retrieved passages cover only the first page of M-25-22, so I can't confirm its specific requirements. I also can't say whether any M-24-18 provisions were carried over. For the details, consult the full M-25-22 document.
